bio_en: Sedrak Sasuni was born in August 1896 in Aharonk, Sasun, into the ancient Mamikonian (Mankoyents) family, the younger brother of Karo and Armen Sasuni; three of his brothers and his mother were killed in Mush prison in March 1915. He studied in Tigranakert, where in 1908-09 he led the youth movement, and from 1910 at the Getronagan school in Constantinople, graduating in 1914. Deported in 1915 with the community of Rodosto to the deserts of Der Zor, he survived by chance and became a prominent ARF activist. He was murdered in his Paris apartment on the evening of 7 December 1936.
